entry.eyebrow: Broadleaf Lancero split into short premium sessions
entry.summaryHtml: Dark chocolate, espresso, walnut, charred oak, earth and black pepper form a dense, savoury-sweet Broadleaf profile. The smoke is expected to be oily and chewy, with cocoa and roasted coffee through the aroma and a long finish of leather, oak, pepper and dark sweetness. The 40-ring Lancero should keep the wrapper prominent without the bulk of the larger Tabernacle formats.
entry.noteHtml: Card represents one pre-light half of the 7″ × 40 Connecticut Broadleaf Lancero.
